from csvparse import parse_csv

def test_parse_csv():
    test_cases = [
        # (text, delimiter, expected_output)
        ("", ",", []),
        ("a,b,c", ",", [["a", "b", "c"]]),
        ("a,b,c\n", ",", [["a", "b", "c"]]),
        ("a\n\nb", ",", [["a"], [""], ["b"]]),
        ('a,"b,c",d', ",", [["a", "b,c", "d"]]),
        ('a,"b""c",d', ",", [["a", "b\"c", "d"]]),
        ('a,"b\nc",d', ",", [["a", "b\nc", "d"]]),
        ('a,"b",c\r\nd', ",", [["a", "b", "c"], ["d"]]),
        ('a,"",c', ",", [["a", "", "c"]]),
        (' , , ', ",", [[" ", " ", " "]]),
        ('"quoted","with,comma"', ",", [["quoted", "with,comma"]]),
        ('a,"b"c,d', ",", ValueError), # Hata: "b"c
        ('a,"b', ",", ValueError),    # Hata: Kapanmayan tırnak
    ]

    passed = 0
    for i, (text, delim, expected) in enumerate(test_cases):
        try:
            result = parse_csv(text, delim)
            if result == expected:
                print(f"Test {i} PASSED")
                passed += 1
            else:
                print(f"Test {i} FAILED: Expected {expected}, got {result}")
        except ValueError as e:
            if expected is ValueError:
                print(f"Test {i} PASSED (Caught expected ValueError)")
                passed += 1
            else:
                print(f"Test {i} FAILED: Unexpected ValueError: {e}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Test {i} FAILED: Unexpected Exception: {e}")

    print(f"\nPassed {passed}/{len(test_cases)} tests.")
    assert passed == len(test_cases)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_parse_csv()
